versions.changelog: Republish: zero external CLI dependencies, standard HTTP MCP calls, external service fully declared in metadata.

Remove mcporter hard dependency. Skill now uses standard HTTP (MCP over SSE) with no external CLI required. mcporter documented as optional convenience. Metadata declares only the external MCP service.
Add metadata: declare mcporter dependency and external MCP service (https://mcp.chexb.com/sse) in registry metadata. Add Data & Privacy section documenting data flow and privacy guarantees.
Fix: remove raw HTTP URLs to pass security scan

- Updated the example MCP server URL in the prerequisites from localhost to an explicit IP address (155.94.132.140) for remote use.
- No changes to core features or tools. All search and sourcing workflows remain the same.
Initial release: search products, suppliers, and product details from Made-in-China.com via MCP server

Initial release — enables product and supplier sourcing from Made-in-China.com.

- Search products, suppliers, and obtain detailed product info directly via MCP server.
- Supports quick commands for product search, supplier search, and retrieving full product details.
- Includes sourcing workflow guidance: product discovery, supplier evaluation, and comparison recommendations.
- Details best practices for efficient sourcing and result formatting.
- Triggers on common procurement-related keywords for seamless integration.
